data.name: MMA Sim King
data.detailed_description:
This text-based simulation allows you to control and grow your very own MMA promotion. Take the reigns of an established global powerhouse, or begin from the bottom with upcoming regional talent, the choice is yours.

  • Book the Fights

Put together events that entertain critics and crowds alike. Test the champion, match up contenders, push the upcoming prospects, or pit rivals against each other to settle the bad blood.

  • A True Mix of Martial Arts

Compete against (or run) promotions that step outside the realm of MMA, including boxing, bare knuckle, kickboxing, karate, grappling and wrestling.

  • Detailed Simulation

With over 60 different stats, each fighter feels different. Various personality types mean that one fighter may favor making money, while the other aims to build their legacy and retire as an all-time great.

  • See it Live

Watch the fights unfold with play-by-play commentary. From the knockdowns to the knockouts, cuts to doctor stoppages, unanimous decisions and even controversial ones.

  • Pre-Fight Hype

Hold press conferences and field questions to build the event. Some reporters choose softball questions, while others aim to instigate in the hopes of witnessing the classic press conference brawl.

  • Dealing with the Drama

From missed weight to arrests and drug test failures, your job doesn't end at making fights. Find last-minute replacements from within our outside your promotion, enticing them with more money or a guaranteed title shot.

  • Compete in a Living World

Other promotions will be running events, signing talent and negotiating for the same broadcasting deals you are. Keep your fighters satisfied, or risk a rival company poaching them.

  • Make it Yours

A full in-game databased editor allows you to reshape the world, or create your own from scratch. Download databases created by other players, or share yours with the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: N/A
